reuse.why: The new action reuses category selection, amount conversion, batching, budget writes, and undo wrappers, but setZero duplicates the existing category-loading query.

duplication.why: Eligibility rules remain centralized, but the category/group/notes query is repeated in setZero and getAverageFillCategories.

placement.why: Budget selection and amount logic stay in actions.ts, while method registration uses the established app.ts wrappers.

scope.why: The edits address the requested month-wide actions except for adding an unused includeHiddenCategories argument to resetIncomeCarryover.

maintainability.why: The shared eligibility predicate keeps future rule changes manageable, though duplicated loading logic and an unused public argument should be cleaned up.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All affected budget-fill actions use isCategoryFilled directly or through getAverageFillCategories, and the new action reuses averageToBudgetAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated category-loading SQL is explicit rather than renamed or reshaped to conceal duplication.

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories is added to isCategoryFilled and getAverageFillCategories; isCategoryFilled gains hidden, template, and fixed-group guards plus an include-hidden ternary, while all fill callers retain shared eligibility.
